title: MASAI: AI-assisted mammography screening in a randomized trial
summary: In the initial analysis of 80,033 women, AI-assisted screening detected 244 cancers versus 203 with standard double reading and reduced the reading workload by 44%. A Lund update on January 30, 2026, after more than two years and about 106,000 women, reports higher sensitivity without more false positives. The comparison is in a Swedish setting; it does not demonstrate reduced mortality.
ai_technology: AI for mammogram triage and marking
